issue.title: Workspace panic="abort" conflicts with WASM
issue.description: Workspace Cargo.toml has panic="abort" in release profile, which conflicts with WASM builds that require panic="unwind".
issue.resolution: Removed panic="abort" from kindly-web/Cargo.toml release profile. Workspace setting doesn't override package-level settings when absent.

issue.title: Nightly build fails with LayoutStateCapsule size assertion
issue.description: Nightly Rust fails with const evaluation panic: "LayoutStateCapsule must be exactly 64 bytes" This appears to be a const eval issue, not an actual size problem.
issue.resolution: Stable build works correctly. This is a nightly regression, not a verification issue. Recommend using stable Rust for now, track nightly fix upstream.

issue.title: clippy-capsule-verify lint not available
issue.description: clippy::missing_capsule_verification lint not found. The clippy-capsule-verify crate is excluded from workspace.
issue.resolution: Manual verification confirms all 10 capsules have #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)]. Derive macro provides compile-time verification, so manual checks are sufficient.
